gizmo.title: Hero
gizmo.description: Chithunzi chachikulu, GIF kapena kanema yokhala ndi mutu ndi zolemba pamwamba pake, yoyikidwa paliponse patsamba.

configure.title: Chithunzi kapena kanema
configure.description: Fayilo ya JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4 kapena WebM.

configure.title: Zolemba zina
configure.description: Fotokozani chithunzi. Siyani chopanda kanthu ngati ndi chokongoletsa chokha.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Mutu wowonetsedwa pamwamba pa media. Siyani chopanda kanthu kuti pasakhale.

configure.title: Zolemba
configure.description: Zolemba zowonetsedwa pansi pa mutu, pamwamba pa media.

configure.title: M'lifupi mwathunthu
configure.description: Yendani kuchokera m'mbali mpaka m'mbali m'malo mokhala mu gawo la zomwe zili mkati.

configure.title: Kuyika m'chimango
configure.description: Momwe chithunzi chimakhalira pa kukula kulikonse kwa sikirini

advanced.title: Kuzimiririka
advanced.description: Mtundu woyikidwa pamwamba pa media. Pakakhala mutu kapena zolemba umakhalapo nthawi zonse, kuti zolemba zikhalebe zowerengeka.

advanced.title: Malo ofunikira modutsa
advanced.description: Gawo la chithunzi lomwe limakhalabe lowonekera chikadulidwa, kuchokera 0 (kumanzere) mpaka 100 (kumanja).

advanced.title: Malo ofunikira motsika
advanced.description: Gawo la chithunzi lomwe limakhalabe lowonekera chikadulidwa, kuchokera 0 (pamwamba) mpaka 100 (pansi).
